blurb: Paramount Water Sports offers jet ski rentals and guided tours in Downtown Tampa, letting both locals and visitors experience Tampa Bay from the water. Located across from popular restaurants and hotels, their services include guided rides and specialty experiences such as Sunset Ride & Dine. The fleet features Sea-Doo GTX 130HP jet skis. Various ride options are available, including single and tandem rides.
